name: dkj-solutions
displayName: Claude Specialists - DKJ policy for DKJ-Solutions (policy scaffold, DKJ-Solutions scope)
description: DKJ-Solutions' codex: the binding rules every DKJ-Solutions app shares, packaged so they are written once instead of rebuilt per repo. The counterpart of bwj-development for the other organisation, and an ADDITIVE add-on to dkj-policy that contradicts nothing it decides. One chapter so far. THE HOUSE STYLE: one set of design tokens, twelve themes a user picks from (six light, six dark) and one base stylesheet for every page, report, dashboard or Artifact a DKJ-Solutions app renders. The files live in the public DKJ-Solutions/dkj-brandbook repo; the house-style skill points there and carries the rules a session needs before it fetches them. A repo adds its own domain tokens and components on top and never redefines a house token. It also ships one SessionStart hook, DEV-PREVIEW: a repo whose scripts/repo-config.ps1 states Get-DevPreview (the command, the port or port range, the URL path) gets its local dev server started or reused at session start and its localhost link handed to the owner and the session; a repo that states nothing pays nothing. Carries no specialists. Requires dkj-subagents-alpha and dkj-policy. Enable this in DKJ-Solutions repos only -- never in BWJ-Development, which has its own styling.
